scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist dist-ssr && node scripts/compat.mjs dist/assets dist/index.html
scripts.build:single: vite build --mode single && vite build --mode single --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr-single && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist-single dist-ssr-single && node scripts/compat.mjs dist-single/index.html && node scripts/finish-single.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:single
